name: Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana
benefit:
> **Financial Support: Beneficiaries receive ₹1,31,500/- for constructing houses under the scheme:** 1. First Installment: ₹40,000/- upon approval of the house. 1. Second Installment: ₹75,000/- after window sealing. 1. Third Installment: ₹16,500/- upon completing the house, including painting.
> **Incentives for Monitoring: Panchayat Volunteers or SHGs receive ₹500 per house in phases:**
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe community in Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must fall under the economically weaker section. 
1. Only individuals residing in rural areas are eligible.
